jobs.prompt: A 1536x1024 sprite sheet laid out as a strict 2-column by 4-row grid of eight equal cells, read left to right then top to bottom, showing one attack effect across eight animation frames: 1 anticipation, 2 release, 3 travel, 4 travel, 5 pre-contact, 6 contact peak, 7 reaction, 8 dissipation. Hand-painted storybook game VFX with dark confident outlines and restrained afterglow, matching the rendering, line weight and cell framing of the reference sheet exactly. The effect body only: no characters, no creatures, no scenery, no floor, no UI, no text, no numbers, no frame borders. Every cell sits on the same flat uniform cyan chroma background for keying. Critical: the effect itself must contain no cyan, aqua, turquoise or pale sky-blue anywhere, so that it stays clearly separable from the cyan background when the background is keyed out. The effect is a stack of concentric sound rings ringing outward from a knot of rope-like echoes. Frame 1 the rings compress inward into a tight bright knot. Frames 2-4 they burst and expand outward as wide overlapping halos that sweep the whole width of the cell. Frame 6 the widest ring flares hardest with a thin cream-white rim. Frames 7-8 the halos thin, break into short arcs and fade. Palette: dusty lavender and deep indigo, warm silver-grey stone, cream highlights.
